note: Only add dates from company releases, SEC filings, FDA or EMA (trade press only when it reports the primary source). 'confirmed' is the date of the source that last stated the timing. 'date' is set only for an exact day; 'when' is what the source says. Trials: industry-sponsored phase 3 and pivotal phase 2/3 retina trials that are recruiting or active, plus large network trials (DRCR/Jaeb and major multicenter academic studies). 'kind': 'trial' entries are dated by the estimated primary completion on ClinicalTrials.gov; replace with company readout guidance ('kind': 'readout') when a company states one. Before adding or keeping a trial, confirm it has not already reported results (company releases, SEC filings, trade press, registry results); if it has, drop it or move it to resolved. Every trial or readout title includes the trial acronym when one exists (registry acronym field, or the sponsor's name for the trial).

items.title: Fovlussea, a ranibizumab biosimilar (Accord Healthcare)
items.detail: CHMP adopted a positive opinion at its Oct 12–15 meeting. The European Commission decision is pending.

items.title: SZN-8141 DUET phase 1b/2a (Surrozen)
items.detail: FDA cleared the IND Oct 2; the second tranche of Surrozen's private placement, about $95.1 million, funds the DUET study in DME.

items.title: Tinlarebant for Stargardt disease type 1 (Belite Bio)
items.detail: PDUFA date for the NDA, which is under priority review.

items.title: 4D-150 4FRONT-1 phase 3 topline (4DMT)
items.detail: North American trial; randomization completed (N=523) in March 2026.

items.title: 4D-150 4FRONT-2 phase 3 topline (4DMT)
items.detail: Global trial; enrollment completed in June 2026, with more than 500 patients expected to be randomized.

items.title: Duravyu COMO and CAPRI phase 3 topline (EyePoint)
items.detail: Vorolanib insert in DME; the two trials enrolled 551 patients. EyePoint now prioritizes DME after ending its wet AMD trials early.

items.title: Sura-vec (ABBV-RGX-314) ATMOSPHERE and ASCENT pivotal topline (AbbVie, REGENXBIO)
items.detail: Subretinal gene therapy vs ranibizumab (ATMOSPHERE, n=671) and vs aflibercept (ASCENT, n=735) in nAMD.

items.title: Vonaprument (ANX007) ARCHER II phase 3 topline (Annexon)
items.detail: Intravitreal C1q inhibitor vs sham in GA (n=659); Month 15 primary analysis topline expected Q4 2026, with a Month 24 dual primary endpoint added (completion expected Q3 2027).

items.title: Tabirafusp alfa (KSI-101) PEAK Pivotal Analysis 1 topline (Kodiak)
items.detail: Intravitreal tabirafusp alfa vs sham in macular edema secondary to inflammation; Pivotal Analysis 1 covers the first 300 PEAK patients (PEAK total n=600).

items.title: Tabirafusp alfa (KSI-101) PEAK/PINNACLE Pivotal Analysis 2 topline (Kodiak)
items.detail: Pivotal Analysis 2 pools PEAK patients 301–600 with PINNACLE (n=300), vs sham in macular edema secondary to inflammation.

items.title: Ixo-vec ARTEMIS phase 3 (Adverum)
items.detail: Intravitreal gene therapy vs aflibercept in nAMD (n=311); active, not recruiting.

items.title: Ixo-vec AQUARIUS phase 3 (Adverum)
items.detail: Intravitreal gene therapy vs aflibercept in nAMD (n=534); recruiting.

items.title: Axitinib implant (OTX-TKI) SOL-R phase 3 topline in nAMD (Ocular Therapeutix)
items.detail: Primary endpoint: Week 56 BCVA non-inferiority vs aflibercept 2 mg (640 randomized); sponsor masking extended to Week 96 with a new key secondary endpoint of superiority vs aflibercept 8 mg.

items.title: Tiespectus (EYE201/MK-8748) MALBEC and TORRONTES pivotal phase 2/3 trials in nAMD (EyeBiotech, Merck)
items.detail: Two trials vs aflibercept 2 mg (n=960 each); recruiting. Second trial est. completion Jul 2028.

items.title: OLN324 MOJAVE and SAHARA phase 3 trials in nAMD (Ollin Biosciences)
items.detail: Two trials: vs aflibercept (n=500) and monthly vs ranibizumab (n=400); not yet recruiting.

items.title: ABP 938 8 mg vs Eylea HD in nAMD (Amgen)
items.detail: Proposed aflibercept 8 mg biosimilar comparative trial (n=304); recruiting.

items.title: Port Delivery System 36-week refill, Velodrome phase 3b (Roche)
items.detail: 36-week refill regimen of the ranibizumab port delivery system in nAMD (n=451); active, not recruiting.

items.title: LX102 STELLAR phase 3 (Innostellar)
items.detail: Subretinal gene therapy vs aflibercept in nAMD (n=388); recruiting.

items.title: DRCR Protocol AO: home OCT-guided vs treat-and-extend faricimab (Jaeb Center)
items.detail: Phase 3 comparing home OCT-guided dosing with treat-and-extend in nAMD (n=603); active, not recruiting.

items.title: TIGER: vitrectomy, subretinal tPA and gas for submacular hemorrhage (King's College Hospital)
items.detail: Phase 3 surgical trial in submacular hemorrhage from nAMD (n=210); recruiting.

items.title: Axitinib implant (OTX-TKI) HELIOS-3 phase 3 in NPDR (Ocular Therapeutix)
items.detail: AXPAXLI every 12 months (Q48W) vs sham in moderately severe to severe NPDR (about 620 subjects, reduced from 930); primary endpoint DRSS 2-step change at Week 56. Design change per Ocular Therapeutix release, Aug 3, 2026; registry date may be revised.

items.title: Tiespectus (MK-8748) SANGIOVESE and SYRAH phase 3 trials in DME (Merck)
items.detail: Two trials vs aflibercept 2 mg (n=960 and n=1,104); recruiting. Second trial est. completion Nov 2028. Trial names per Merck release, Oct 10, 2026.

items.title: OLN324 ATACAMA and GOBI phase 3 trials in DME (Ollin Biosciences)
items.detail: Two trials vs aflibercept (n=450 each); not yet recruiting.

items.title: Remigromig (EYE103) BAROLO pivotal phase 2b/3 trial in DME (EyeBiotech, Merck)
items.detail: Remigromig vs ranibizumab 0.5 mg (n=1,054); active, not recruiting.

items.title: 4D-150 4SIGHT phase 3 in DME (4DMT)
items.detail: Single intravitreal gene therapy injection vs aflibercept (n=514); recruiting.

items.title: Tabirafusp tedromer ALTO phase 3 in DME (Kodiak)
items.detail: Tabirafusp tedromer 5 mg vs aflibercept 2 mg (n=910); recruiting.

items.title: Sura-vec NAAVIGATE phase 2b/3 in diabetic retinopathy (AbbVie)
items.detail: Suprachoroidal gene therapy vs sham in DR without center-involved DME (n=576); recruiting.

items.title: AVT29 ALVOEYE-HD vs Eylea HD in DME (Alvotech)
items.detail: Proposed aflibercept 8 mg biosimilar comparative trial (n=256); recruiting.

items.title: BAT5906 phase 3 in DME (Bio-Thera)
items.detail: BAT5906 vs ranibizumab (n=406); recruiting.

items.title: DRCR Protocol AF: fenofibrate to prevent DR worsening (Jaeb Center)
items.detail: Phase 3 fenofibrate vs placebo (n=563); active, not recruiting.

items.title: DRCR Protocol AP: faricimab plus PRP vs vitrectomy with endolaser for PDR (Jaeb Center)
items.detail: Phase 3 in proliferative diabetic retinopathy (n=426); recruiting.

items.title: Semaglutide FOCUS trial in diabetic retinopathy (Novo Nordisk)
items.detail: Semaglutide vs placebo in type 2 diabetes, assessing effects on retinopathy (n=1,500); active, not recruiting.

items.title: Pozelimab plus cemdisiran SIENNA phase 3 in GA (Regeneron)
items.detail: Subcutaneous pozelimab with cemdisiran, or cemdisiran alone, vs placebo (n=975); recruiting.

items.title: Tinlarebant PHOENIX phase 3 in GA (Belite Bio)
items.detail: Oral tinlarebant vs placebo (n=429); active, not recruiting.

items.title: Elamipretide ReNEW phase 3 in dry AMD (Stealth BioTherapeutics)
items.detail: Subcutaneous elamipretide vs placebo (n=313); active, not recruiting.

items.title: OCU410 ArMaDa3 phase 3 in GA (Ocugen)
items.detail: Registrational trial of OCU410 in GA (n=237); recruiting. Trial name per Ocugen Q2 2026 release.

items.title: OCU400 liMeliGhT phase 3 topline in retinitis pigmentosa (Ocugen)
items.detail: Subretinal modifier gene therapy vs untreated control (n=140, enrollment complete); rolling BLA tied to this readout.

items.title: OCU410ST GARDian3 phase 2/3 topline in Stargardt disease (Ocugen)
items.detail: Subretinal gene therapy; 63 subjects dosed; BLA planned mid-2027.

items.title: Sepofarsen HYPERION phase 3 in CEP290 LCA10 (Laboratoires Théa)
items.detail: Intravitreal RNA therapy vs placebo, paired-eye design (n=32); recruiting.

items.title: ATSN-201 LIGHTHOUSE in X-linked retinoschisis (Atsena)
items.detail: Phase 1/2/3 gene therapy trial with a randomized controlled part (n=97); recruiting.

items.title: Tinlarebant DRAGON II phase 2/3 in Stargardt disease (Belite Bio)
items.detail: Phase 1b in Japanese patients, then a randomized placebo-controlled phase 2/3 (n=60); active, not recruiting.

items.title: Gildeuretinol (ALK-001) NORTHSTAR phase 3 in Stargardt disease (Alkeus)
items.detail: Oral gildeuretinol vs placebo (n=230); recruiting.

items.title: NAC Attack: oral N-acetylcysteine in retinitis pigmentosa (Johns Hopkins)
items.detail: Phase 3 vs placebo (n=485); active, not recruiting.

items.title: NPI-001 SLORP Preserve and companion phase 3 trials in Usher syndrome RP (Nacuity)
items.detail: Two 24-month trials of NPI-001 vs placebo (n=80 each); one recruiting, one not yet. Second est. completion Jul 2029.

items.title: L-serine SEErine phase 3 in MacTel type 2 (Lowy Medical Research Institute)
items.detail: Oral serine vs placebo (n=120); not yet recruiting.

items.title: VGR-R01 phase 3 in Bietti crystalline dystrophy (Vitalgen)
items.detail: Gene therapy, randomized controlled (n=45); active, not recruiting.

items.title: Belzupacap sarotalocan (bel-sar) CoMpass phase 3 in small choroidal melanoma (Aura)
items.detail: Suprachoroidal bel-sar vs sham in indeterminate lesions or small choroidal melanoma (n=108); active, not recruiting.

items.title: Neoadjuvant darovasertib OptimUM-10 phase 3 in uveal melanoma (IDEAYA)
items.detail: Neoadjuvant darovasertib before primary local therapy in non-metastatic uveal melanoma (n=520); recruiting.

items.title: COMBAT: sequential vs combined phacovitrectomy for RRD (Queen's University Belfast)
items.detail: Phase 3 equivalence trial in rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (n=276); recruiting.

items.title: Laru-zova VISTA, X-linked RP (Beacon)
items.detail: The pivotal VISTA trial met its primary endpoint; a rolling BLA is planned.

items.title: Duravyu LUCIA, wet AMD
items.detail: Missed BCVA noninferiority vs aflibercept 2 mg; effect sizes not disclosed.

items.title: Fovlussea (ranibizumab biosimilar), CHMP
items.detail: CHMP recommends approval; the European Commission decision is pending.
